For MxPro5 panels covered by user guide 680-166, revision 04.

Use authorised Level 2 access with permission for the operation. User permissions differ; use the access key if fitted, or MENU → ENABLE CONTROLS and your authorised password.

Only trained service personnel should carry out installation, programming or maintenance of this equipment.

This documented route is for an individual input device. Outputs use a different menu.

1. Press MENU, select DISABLE → ZONE/INPUTS, then scroll to the required zone or enter its number.
2. Move to the Mode column, highlight its existing mode and press ✔. Choose SELECTED INPUTS so the panel lists the input devices in that zone.
3. Check the required input against its device information, then highlight that input and press ✔ to disable it. Press Esc to return.

The DISABLE indicator shows when zones, input devices or output devices are disabled.

message.text:
Got it. You’re asking about 4 parts:

1. Disable sounders
For MxPro5 panels covered by user guide 680-166, revision 04.

Use authorised Level 2 access with permission for the operation. User permissions differ; use the access key if fitted, or MENU → ENABLE CONTROLS and your authorised password.

Only trained service personnel should carry out installation, programming or maintenance of this equipment.

1. Press MENU. Select DISABLE, then OUTPUTS, using the arrows and ✔. If prompted, enter your authorised password.

Disabled outputs will not activate for a fire alarm or another programmed event. The available output options depend on how the installation engineer configured the system.
